scope: one real skull-stripped T1 and MNI152 2-mm brain template; identical input, reference, and saved FSL FLIRT affine; FSL FNIRT without --config versus FNIT default preset
input_provenance: same subject and inputs as the T1 FNIRT fMRI validation; skull-stripping provenance of T1 is unknown

fsl_reference.acceptance: conditional: process returned 255 after writing coefficient and warped images; both passed gzip CRC, finite-value, grid and coefficient-format checks

metric_definition.warped_pearson_and_mae: warped T1 Pearson r and MAE within voxels where reference brain image > 0
metric_definition.support_dice: each warped T1 thresholded at 5% of its positive 99th percentile; Dice on output grid
metric_definition.coefficient_pearson_and_mae: all cubic B-spline coefficient array elements, matching [21,24,21,3] grids

comparison_limit: matching command settings and NIfTI contracts do not establish numerical equivalence; FSL status 255 makes this a conditional output comparison
timing_limit: FSL CPU and FNIT GPU shared resources and were not an isolated paired speed test
privacy: only scalars and SHA256 hashes are published; source images and voxelwise outputs stay on the remote server
